About MoneyLion MoneyLion is a leader in financial technology powering the next generation of personalized products and content, with a top consumer finance super app, a premier embedded finance platform for enterprise businesses and a world-class media arm. MoneyLion’s mission is to give everyone the power to make their best financial decisions. We pride ourselves on serving the many, not the few; providing confidence through guidance, choice, personalization; and shortening the distance to an informed action. In our go-to money app for consumers, we deliver curated content on finance and related topics, through a tailored feed that engages people to learn and share. MoneyLion’s enterprise technology provides the definitive search engine and marketplace for financial products, enabling any company to add embedded finance to their business, with advanced AI-backed data and tools through our platform and API. Established in 2013, MoneyLion connects millions of people with the financial products and content they need, when and where they need it. About the Role The Kuala Lumpur office serves as the beating heart of innovation for MoneyLion, where creativity and speed converge to challenge the status quo of finance. Our environment celebrates diversity and the spirit of rebellion against traditional financial norms. We're on the lookout for enthusiastic junior to mid-level engineers ready to embark on a transformative journey in fintech. As part of our dynamic engineering team, you'll contribute to the development and refinement of microservices and RESTful APIs. These are the core components that enable our consumer financial products to excel across various platforms. Dive into a role where your work directly impacts the evolution of fintech, blending your passion for software building with our mission to revolutionize financial services. Key Responsibilities: - Developing innovative features in the Fintech industry. - Participating in architecting and implementing event-driven architecture. - Working with industry standards of CI/CD best practices at enterprise level. jobs.description_text: About the Role The Kuala Lumpur office is the technology powerhouse of MoneyLion, where we measure anything and everything and rely on data to guide our decisions: both long-term strategies and day-to-day operations. Combine that backdrop with an incredible volume and sophistication of data and mix in MoneyLion’s voracious appetite for adopting paradigm-shifting technologies and you have the mission and mandate of the Data Engineering team. Now turbo-charged with a planetscale mandate as part of Gen Digital, we aim to leverage tried-and-true methodologies with game-changing technology to create a AI-native, scalable, extensible, and cost-effective data infrastructure across the Gen Digital enterprise and beyond. As a Data Engineer, you are a technical Individual Contributor (IC) figure within the team that will design, implement and optimize a Snowflake-centric architecture that will leverage many components of the modern data stack. You will be a trusted subject matter expert on dimensional data modeling, performant SQL query writing, infrastructure optimization, process automation and governance. You will be given the opportunity to leverage the latest and greatest AI tools and features, including Claude Code (Enterprise) and Snowflake’s Cortex Code, among many others. You will be responsible for designing and implementing an analytical environment using in-house and third-party tools, using Python and/or Java to automate data activities and enable efficient processing of data that is growing in both volume and complexity. You will design and implement complex data pipelines and data models for analytical consumption. You will write scalable and performant SQL queries running over billions of rows of data and design workflows aimed to ruthlessly streamline the governance of our complex layers of storage. You should have deep experience in designing and managing large datasets and pipelines to enable business use-cases. You should be an authority at designing, implementing and operating solutions that are scalable, stable and cost-efficient. Above all, you will be an authority on crafting thoughtful solutions that will empower absolutely everyone at Gen Digital towards an agentic AI-first analytics and development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities - Extensive expertise operating & optimizing a modern data warehousing solution (Snowflake preferred) from both performance and cost perspectives. - Expertise with Apache Kafka, real-time data processing, and event-driven architectures - Experience with Apache Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures, and modern table formats - Collaborate with data scientists, business analysts, product managers, software engineers and other data engineers to develop, implement and validate deployed data solutions. - Build and maintain data pipelines from internal databases and SaaS applications - Implement better solutions for data governance at scale, encompassing lineage, discoverability, and regulatory compliance. - Advocate best practices, uphold the highest standards for code maintainability and performance, and constantly champion our team’s core values of psychological safety and building in public. - Lead the team in honing our ways of working, coaching and mentoring junior engineers, and managing senior stakeholders from external departments. About You - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or related technical field - 1-4 years of hands-on data engineering experience in large-scale, high-volume environments - Expert-level proficiency in SQL optimization for multi-petabyte datasets and advanced Python programming - Experience with Snowflake architecture, optimization, and cost management at enterprise scale - Demonstrated expertise building Kimball dimensional data warehouses and star schema architectures, or equivalent experience with thoughtful, non-generic projects - Advanced experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and either DBT or SQLMesh for data transformations - Familiarity with AWS is a big plus - Experience in planning day to day tasks, knowing how and what to prioritise and overseeing their execution What's Next... After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process: 1. Online Preliminary Codility test 2. Recruiter Screening Call 3. Take-home Assessment 4. Take Home Discussion (Virtual) 5. Interview - Hiring Manager (Virtual or face-to-face), 1.5 hours

jobs.description_text: The Role As our Lead Specialist for Data Scientist (Analytics), you will be the strategic voice behind our product development, turning complex data into relevant experiments that shape the bank's future. This isn't just an analytics role; it's an opportunity to lead the data lifecycle, pioneer Generative AI programs, and directly influence how we build products at GXBank. What You'll Do: Partner with product, design, and engineering teams to obtain insights, design experiments, and lead important product decisions. Support strategic plans with data insights, performing deep-dives into user behavior, segmented views and product efficacy. Provide tailored analysis for specific products and strategies, define critical business and product metrics, and make regular recommendations for continuous improvements. Design, measure, and recommend A/B tests and multivariate experiments, including layout optimisation, UI/UX efficacy, algorithm effectiveness, and API performance. Analyse clickstream and transactional data to uncover insights on user behaviour and guide product metrics. You will manage instrumentation for all feature releases within assigned tech families within the bank. Develop self-serve solutions for partners that are scalable and automated to handle a product environment. Guide plans involving Large Language Models or Generative Artificial Intelligence Who We Are Looking For: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields. Minimum 5 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science, preferably in a Bank or Tech (FinTech or E-Commerce) company. Proficient in writing advanced SQL queries, Python and querying large relational databases. Skilled in data visualisation platforms like Tableau or HTML to present findings. Experience translating data insights into relevant recommendations for non-technical and senior team members. jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The GrabFood Analytics team is part of ACE Analytics, which covers GrabFood, GrabMart, GrabExpress and OmniCommerce. We are the product analytics partners to the GrabFood product organisation across six Southeast Asian markets. Each analyst owns one or two product problem spaces end-to-end. They define the metrics that matter, design and read the experiments behind every launch, and run the deep dives that decide what gets built next. We work AI-first: analysts build and share reusable AI workflows that take on the repetitive parts of the job, so our time goes to judgement and product thinking. This is a new seat, created to take on additional product problem spaces. Get to Know the Role Reporting to the Senior Analytics Manager, you will be the analytics owner. You will also be the advisor for one to two GrabFood product problem spaces. These problem spaces may include, for example, ordering experience and conversion, merchant discovery and content, delivery reliability and demand shaping, or affordability and promotions. You will work directly with the product manager, designers, engineers and data scientists for that space, most of whom are based in Singapore, and with country teams across the region. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You set the metrics. You design an experiment and read it. You make the ship, iterate or stop recommendation and hold it when the data says so. You decide what to prioritise when several partners need you in the same week. This is a product analytics role, not a machine-learning role: your time goes to metrics, experiments, root-cause analysis and product decisions, not to model building. We base this role in Petaling Jaya and will require you to work onsite. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform You will define the metrics for your problem space: the primary metric at the exact step a feature changes, the leading and lagging indicators around it, and the guardrails that catch the failure modes. You will design and analyse controlled experiments with your product manager: hypothesis, randomisation unit, success metric, sample size and duration, guardrails, and the checks that keep a result honest. You will turn results into a clear ship, iterate or stop recommendation. You will diagnose metric movements systematically. This will involve, locating the movement, decomposing it, cutting it by funnel step, segment, platform, and market. After that, ruling out tracking and data-quality causes. Finally, explaining it why. You will size opportunities and run proactive deep dives into consumer, merchant and driver-partner behaviour that shape the roadmap rather than report on it. You will oversee the data specifications and instrumentation for new features with engineering, so the data exists to measure what you planned to measure. You will build the dashboards and certified metrics that give the product team reliable self-serve visibility. You will build AI-assisted analytics workflows for yourself and the team, validated against raw data and business logic, and share what works. You will improve on experimentation and analytical rigour across the problem spaces you touch, and coach junior analysts as the team grows. What Essential Skills You Will Need At least 4 years in analytics or quantitative roles, with at least 2 years of experience where you owned the metrics for a consumer product, growth, pricing, CRM, or marketing programme. Experience in data analytics is a bonus. It is especially valuable in industries such as food or grocery delivery and e-commerce marketplaces. It is also valuable in ride-hailing and super-apps, e-wallets and digital banking, travel, telco digital products, and consumer FinTech. Fluent SQL on large datasets, and proficient Python or R for analysis. Hands-on experience designing and analysing controlled experiments: A/B tests, holdouts, or well-designed quasi-experiments such as difference-in-differences or synthetic control where randomisation was not possible. You can explain why you chose the design, what could bias it, and how you read a result that is not clean. Sound statistics applied to decisions: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample size and power, multiple comparisons, selection bias and mix shifts. You can explain these in plain language to a product manager, and you know when a method breaks. Precise metric framing: You can define the right metric for a change. This includes specifying its numerator, denominator, and the population it is measured on. Additionally, you can distinguish a feature-engagement metric from a conversion metric. Structured solutioning on ambiguous questions: You lay out the space before you commit to a hypothesis, and you can write the analysis plan before you open a notebook. Manage partner trade-offs: You set priorities across competing asks, say no with reasons, and keep quality on what you ship. You close your own knowledge gaps quickly and act on feedback. Clear communication: you make the finding and the decision clear to product leaders and engineers alike, in writing and live. You use AI tools in your supervised analytics workflow, validating output against raw data and business logic. At least a Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics or another quantitative field. What Would Be Good to Have Experience in food delivery, marketplaces or super-apps across Southeast Asian markets. Experience with an experimentation platform, or having built experiment analysis tooling. Causal inference methods beyond A/B testing. Dashboarding in tools like Tableau, Superset or PowerBI; build data pipelines. Have built a reusable AI workflow, skill or agent that your team adopted. Coach analysts.
